scenarios.prompt: An AI agent requests a route through a passage that opens at runtime. Update the configured navigation representation and revision without assuming a full rebuild, while preserving agent-profile constraints.

criteria.ownership: Navigation owns traversability and path evidence, not physics or world truth.
criteria.revision: Path requests and results are tied to agent profile and navigation revision.
criteria.evidence: Path or no-path results name stable request, revision, and blocking reasons.
